**The menu bar app is gone.** From v0.3.0 gatekeepr is a command-line tool only. If you want `Gatekeepr.app`, use [v0.2.1](https://github.com/akramsaouri/gatekeepr/releases/tag/v0.2.1), the last release that has it.

- **Rewritten in Go.** The commands, flags, text output and exit codes are the same as v0.2.1. They were checked case by case against the Swift version's output, on the test fixtures and on a month of real logs.
- **`--json` is a documented contract.** Every JSON output now has `schemaVersion` (1) and `sessionLengthSource`; nothing else changed. The fields and exit codes are documented in [docs/JSON.md](https://github.com/akramsaouri/gatekeepr/blob/v0.3.0/docs/JSON.md).
- **One download.** A release now has only `gatekeepr-<version>-macos-universal.tar.gz` and `SHA256SUMS`, with the same names and layout as before, so the install commands are unchanged. `Gatekeepr-<version>.zip` is no longer built.
- **Found a parse failure?** If gatekeepr exits with 3 on your Appgate logs, see [Reporting a parse failure](https://github.com/akramsaouri/gatekeepr#reporting-a-parse-failure).
